description: Starter config — copy to smalltalk-mcp.json and set vm.binary and vm.image for your system. Use Squeak or Cuis: just point vm.binary at your VM executable and vm.image at your .image file. See examples/ for all provider options.

_model_examples._note_maxTokens: Set maxTokens to the model's output token limit — vendor and model specific
_model_examples._note_apiKey: Use apiKey to store the key directly in JSON, or apiKeyEnv: 'MY_API_KEY' to read from environment
